security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; worker-src 'self' blob:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Office suite and PDF toolkit that runs entirely on your machine
bundle.longDescription: Office Swiss Army Knife is a local-first desktop suite: the Writer word processor, the Calc spreadsheet, the Impress presentation editor, a document vault and the complete PDF toolkit (merge, split, compress, OCR, watermark, protect, redact, sign, forms, PDF/A). Documents are never uploaded, there is no telemetry, and everything works offline.
